title: Hungary Faces Twin Tests: Fiscal Strains and a State Bank Corruption Probe… · 11 Sep
keywords: Hungary, Eximbank, corruption probe, fiscal deficit, inflation, EU funds, rule of law, Budapest, European Commission, public finances, anti-corruption, National Bank of Hungary, Eurostat, North Macedonia loan
notes: Hungary is navigating a widening budget deficit and a contested inflation picture at the same moment that criminal investigators are examining alleged mismanagement at state-owned export bank Eximbank, including a loan linked to North Macedonia worth around one billion euros. The two developments together raise a pointed question: can Budapest stabilize its public finances while credibly dismantling what critics describe as a culture of institutional abuse? The answer will shape Hungary's standing in Brussels, its access to EU funds, and the daily economic reality for millions of citizens.
